text: Planning a trip is half the fun for me. I spend weeks researching destinations, booking flights, and creating a loose itinerary. Once I arrive, the real adventure begins. I love immersing myself in new cultures, wandering through local markets, and trying dishes I cannot even pronounce. Language barriers are always a challenge, but a smile and a translation app go a long way. Sometimes I get lost or order the wrong thing, but those mistakes often become my favorite stories. In the end, it is not the perfect schedule I remember, but the unexpected moments that stay with me forever.
